about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: 15 Years of OOH Advertising Expertise
about.historyDescription: THINKAD, 'The Thinking Ad Agency,' is a Korean OOH media lab that directly operates and manages domestic landmark displays including COEX K-POP Square and Gangnam-daero Media Pole. Headquartered in Seongsu-dong, Seoul, we provide integrated outdoor advertising solutions that connect brands' online and offline presence across Korea.

adminCrm.title: THINKAD CRM (Advanced)
adminCrm.subtitle: Per-account performance dashboards, AI-style segmentation, auto-reply email, and post-campaign feedback flows in one place.
adminCrm.performanceCompareDesc: For the selected account, compare active and ended campaigns at a glance.
adminCrm.segmentHint: Rule-based tiering from budget, history, performance vs. benchmark, and recency.
adminCrm.aiSegmentationDesc: Scores run on demo data. Refresh updates the run timestamp only.
adminCrm.aiRuleBudgetBand4: Top budget tier — closest to high-value profile.
adminCrm.aiRuleMultiCampaign: Multiple completed campaigns — deeper relationship signal.
adminCrm.aiRuleSingleCampaign: One completed campaign — watch for expansion.
adminCrm.aiRuleCtrUnder: CTR below benchmark — room to improve.
adminCrm.aiRuleRecencyFresh: Recent campaign end — stronger re-booking signal.
adminCrm.aiRuleRecencyStale: Long gap since last flight — consider reactivation.
adminCrm.modelNote: Segmentation and repurchase scores here are rule-based estimates, not a trained ML model. Wire real data and models for production.
adminCrm.autoReplyDesc: Send an acknowledgment (auto-reply) to a lead. Requires SMTP to actually deliver.
adminCrm.feedbackDesc: Email the contact after a campaign ends and point them to the contact page for the survey.
adminCrm.autoScheduleDesc: Queue a feedback email 7 days after campaign end (demo: stored in this session only).
adminCrm.smtpSkipped: SMTP not configured — email was not sent.
adminCrm.batchFeedbackHint: Send feedback-request emails sequentially for {count} ended campaign(s).
adminCrm.autoFeedbackQueueNote: Auto feedback scheduling is on. In production, {count} ended campaign(s) would enqueue for D+7 (demo shows the badge only).

servicesPage.metaDescription: THINKAD: OOH planning, media selection, and flight management. End-to-end outdoor advertising aligned with your goals.
servicesPage.heroSubtitle: We design and execute nationwide media plans for your brand and budget, and manage performance throughout the campaign.
servicesPage.pillar1Body: Media strategy and creative direction grounded in audience, trade areas, and footfall—aligned with your KPIs.
servicesPage.pillar2Body: Curated mix of billboards, DOOH, and transit from a verified network, with rate and placement negotiation.
servicesPage.pillar3Body: Production and install timelines, monitoring, issue resolution, and reporting on delivery and outcomes.
servicesPage.processIntro: From briefing to post-campaign review, we guide you clearly at every step.
servicesPage.step1Body: Align on budget, timing, audience, geography, and must-win messages.
servicesPage.step2Body: Propose mix, flight scenarios, and estimated reach using data and field insight.
servicesPage.step3Body: Lock inventory, rates, and specs; align creative and legal requirements.
servicesPage.step4Body: Asset QA, scheduling, launch checks, and on-the-ground troubleshooting.
servicesPage.step5Body: In-flight checks and wrap-up insights for the next campaign.
servicesPage.ctaSubtitle: Share budget and timing—we’ll respond quickly with direction and next steps.
